name: Brixia

attributes.attribute: the thermal spring site linked to her
linked to Brigit in her healing aspect

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brixia is a Continental Celtic goddess. Her other name is Bricta. She is known from one place. That place is a warm spring at Luxeuil in southern France. Scholars link Brixia to Brigit in her healing aspect.

okr.objective: Describe Brixia, the Continental Celtic goddess of the Luxeuil spring.
key_results: Brixia was a Continental Celtic goddess.
She is known from the thermal spring of Luxeuil.
Scholars link her to Brigit in healing.
